summary: Market tone is mixed-to-cautious: crypto commentators are still talking about altcoin opportunities, but at least one major trader is already taking profits on some positions. The strongest fresh theme today is selective altcoin rotation rather than broad risk-on conviction, while macro and equity-specific updates were not reliably surfaced in the available material.
